reason: Thobes, jalabiyas and bishts are Gulf-style. For Eid and weddings I wear shalwar kameez and desi suits with colour and embroidery, so nothing on that list is what I actually shop for. I might grab a $10 chiffon hijab if I'm passing by after jummah, but I wouldn't go out of my way on opening day for that.
objection: It looks like an Arab boutique. Plain black abayas and thobes aren't my taste, and I don't see anything made for South Asian women like me.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a TikTok or Live from them with colourful embroidered pieces or kaftans styled the way desi aunties dress for Eid and dholkis, at under $60.
